queries.sql:
WITH actuals AS (
        SELECT a.dim_secondary AS member, SUM(a.mapped_amount) AS actual_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS a
        WHERE a.plan_account_code = 'rev-gross'
          AND a.period = '2026-09'
          
          
        GROUP BY a.dim_secondary
      ),
      plan AS (
        SELECT p.dim_secondary AS member, SUM(p.amount) AS plan_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
        WHERE p.account_code = 'rev-gross'
          AND p.version_id = 2
          AND p.period = '2026-09'
          
          
          
        GROUP BY p.dim_secondary
      ),
      combined AS (
        SELECT
          COALESCE(actuals.member, plan.member) AS member,
          COALESCE(actuals.actual_amount, 0) AS actual_amount,
          COALESCE(plan.plan_amount, 0) AS plan_amount
        FROM actuals
        FULL OUTER JOIN plan ON actuals.member = plan.member
      ),
      total AS (
        SELECT SUM(actual_amount) AS total_actual FROM combined
      )
      SELECT
        c.member,
        c.actual_amount,
        c.plan_amount,
        c.actual_amount - c.plan_amount AS delta,
        CASE WHEN c.plan_amount != 0 THEN ((c.actual_amount - c.plan_amount) / ABS(c.plan_amount)) * 100 ELSE NULL END AS delta_pct,
        CASE WHEN t.total_actual != 0 THEN (c.actual_amount / t.total_actual) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS share_pct
      FROM combined c
      CROSS JOIN total t
      ORDER BY c.actual_amount DESC
      LIMIT 10
